An '''individual''' served until [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]] as [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|Director of the]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|intelligence service]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They retired due to ailing health and chose [[Marcus Trant]] as their successor.<ref name="TORenc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The director was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2012]].<ref name="TORenc" />
